items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: See I was one of the first black drummers to be on staff at CBS... there with Raymond, because we were doing the Perry Como show at that time... Raymond, of course, as you know was a superb musician... we used to play the blues, Good Morning Blues program

ctx.x: Yeah, really small hands, too, for a piano player.
Yeah, Johnny can play. Johnny's a good piano player. Tell you something about that. See we were on staff up there with Raymond.
